scope: FreeP native Open and Save As pickers
reason: WPF uses native Windows dialogs and Avalonia uses the platform storage provider. OS-owned picker chrome is not an app-owned cross-host pixel-parity surface.

checks.expected: Cancel leaves the current presentation, path, and dirty state unchanged.
The picker exposes supported PPTX and FXP extensions and rejects unsupported input through the app workflow.
A missing, unreadable, or invalid presentation reports an error without replacing the current presentation.
After cancel or error, focus returns to the owning FreeP window.
Cancel preserves the current path and dirty state.
The selected PPTX or FXP extension controls the saved format; missing extension follows the selected filter/default.
Existing-file overwrite requires the native confirmation path and a declined overwrite leaves the file and document state unchanged.
Write or permission failure is reported without claiming a successful save or clearing dirty state.
After cancel, declined overwrite, or error, focus returns to the owning FreeP window.
